name: Dodol
ingredients: 1 cup black rice flour (or red rice flour)
instructions: 1. Dissolve the jaggery in a little water, strain to remove impurities, and set aside.
2. Mix the rice flour with a portion of the coconut milk to form a smooth, lump-free paste.
3. In a heavy-bottomed pan, combine the remaining coconut milk and the jaggery syrup, bringing it to a simmer.
4. Gradually add the rice flour paste, stirring continuously on low heat to prevent sticking.
5. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and begins to leave the sides of the pan.
6. Add the ghee and chopped cashew nuts, mixing thoroughly.
7. Pour the mixture into a greased tray, smooth the top, and allow it to set and cool before cutting into squares.
description: Dodol is a popular Goan delicacy of Portuguese influence, traditionally prepared during Christmas. It is a dense, sticky, and sweet fudge-like confection that showcases the rich flavors of coconut and palm jaggery.
